## Guardrails

- Do not write only aesthetic adjectives such as "高级感", "电影感", or "氛围感"; translate them into medium domain, style rules, camera, light, motion, material, render vocabulary, rhythm, and composition.
- Do not command emotional transitions only as labels such as "from happy to broken". Use temporal hinge language and visible cues: past residue, present action, incoming pressure, final consequence.
- Do not write texture-rich prompts whose shot function, blocking, axis, screen direction, or edit logic is missing. Fix the audiovisual scaffold first.
- Do not bury the global visual style after the detailed shot list. Later shots inherit the visual master; they should not repeatedly redefine style.
- Do not omit the camera / shot-style master from a substantial copyable video prompt. If the prompt only has event beats, action, material, and stability locks, it is incomplete. The user expects the reusable camera language to appear near the beginning, not be implied.
- Do not let action effects cover the action. Trails must have a source, direction, layer, duration, and decay; they must prove speed, contact, route, force, or transition rather than merely decorate the frame.
- Do not use exact timestamps as decoration. Wrong intervals can force idle holds, premature peaks, slow motion, repeated movement, missing recovery, or rushed transformations.
- Do not confuse useful segment allocation with micro-management. Precise large segments may control emphasis; avoid subdividing every camera cut unless necessary.
- Do not overload a short clip with too many actions. Within each beat, one clear action plus one motivated camera move usually beats five competing instructions; across the whole clip, connect the camera moves through action, impact, occlusion, or receiver handoff.
- Do not describe a heavy weapon without actor-relative load, mass distribution, support, follow-through, and braking.
- Do not let superhuman strength erase traction, recoil, environmental force, or settling.
- Do not turn fantasy power prompts into either pure physics or pure VFX. Keep the power's dramatic function clear, but leave the model room to invent the exact micro-gesture when the user wants looser generation.
- Do not make shadow powers blue/purple by default, or describe them as glowing lines, black fog, black screens, tentacles, or magic explosions unless explicitly requested. Shadow should usually read through absence of light, reflection suppression, silhouette delay, occlusion, and exposure contrast.
- Do not mention old project-specific items inside a new unrelated prompt just to prevent them. If they are not part of the current concept, keep them out of both positive and exclusion prompt.
- For identity consistency, lock visible traits: face, hairstyle, clothing, body type, prop, color, and lighting.
- For first/last frames, describe the transition path rather than inventing a new unrelated scene.
- For multi-reference prompts, state the role of each asset instead of assuming the model knows why it was uploaded.
- Do not present a reference-dependent prompt as ready when a required identity, prop, environment, first/last frame, or layout asset is missing. Name the missing asset and whether it must be generated first.
- Avoid using protected characters, living public figures, brand marks, or copyrighted scenes unless the user has a legitimate reason and asks for them directly; prefer original alternatives.


## Liu Standard Copyable Video Prompt Architecture - Mandatory Positive-Only Gate

This is the mandatory output structure for Liu's copyable AI-video prompts, including Jimeng SD2, Seedance 2.0, all-reference mode, image-to-video, continuation, added shots, transformation clips, action clips, monster clips, character PVs, and camera/shot prompts.

Use this exact order inside the final copyable block unless Liu explicitly requests another format:

```text
角色/资产锁定
...

视觉材质总控
...

镜头语言总控
...

事件节拍
...

声音
...

正向稳定约束
...
```

Hard rules:

- Do not deliver a substantial video prompt as loose natural paragraphs. The six headings are part of Liu's prompt contract.
- Keep the content inside the paste-ready code block as plain model-ready text. The six Chinese section labels may remain, but do not place Markdown tables, `#` headings, `>` quotes, `**` emphasis, citations, diagnostics, or workflow commentary inside the block.
- Do not omit `镜头语言总控`. It must contain the complete whole-film camera style: compatible named anchors plus perspective, lens family, distortion, movement energy, framing/edit rhythm, transition language, and reveal logic, written as concrete style-result phrases. `事件节拍` inherits this master and normally contains only action/state/contact/consequence; write a local camera clause only for a genuine special-camera need, including its trigger and visible result. Repeating the master names or routine camera vocabulary in every beat is a formatting failure. `视觉材质总控` always carries concrete material/light/color/render controls, while its name-style anchors remain conditional.
- Keep `视觉材质总控`. Put concrete material/light/render controls before events. Use named visual-material anchors only when they clarify a decisive material/light/color/render identity; otherwise write direct visible material behavior.
- If no character reference exists, use `角色/资产锁定` for subject, prop, environment, identity, form state, or continuity locks rather than deleting the section.
- Put the first visible frame/state inside the opening sentence of `事件节拍`, e.g. `开场：第一帧就是...`.
- Do not include platform hard parameters in the copyable prompt when Liu says he will set them separately.
- `正向稳定约束` replaces the old exclusion slot. It contains only positive stability locks: subject identity, camera attention, scene relationship, color ownership, material response, sound focus, and readable action path.
- Paste-ready prompt policy: the model-ready code block is positive-only. It states only what is present, visible, audible, active, and locked in the current shot. Exclusion, absence, correction, comparison to old attempts, and previous-failure wording stay outside the copyable block. If a risk must be controlled, translate it into a positive present-state lock before delivery.
- Source-trace gate: every concrete phrase, including existing subjects, props, locations, palettes, camera routines, transitions, powers, sounds, and stability locks, must trace to Liu's current instruction, a supplied/inspected asset, the active global bible/continuity lock, or a user-approved reusable rule. If the trace fails, omit the phrase from the paste-ready prompt or move it outside as a question/assumption.
- If the prompt is missing these sections, contains paste-target exclusion wording, or fails traceability, rewrite it instead of explaining.

Internal ASCII anchors only:

- ROLE_ASSET_LOCK = 角色/资产锁定
- VISUAL_MATERIAL_MASTER = 视觉材质总控
- CAMERA_STYLE_MASTER = 镜头语言总控
- EVENT_BEATS = 事件节拍
- SOUND = 声音
- POSITIVE_STABILITY_LOCKS = 正向稳定约束

body:
---
name: kinetic-action-visual-master
description: 动势动作视觉总纲工具：为高能动作视频建立统一的真实感、动画动势、分镜表达、速度感、材质、色彩和镜头风格。用于动作短片的整体视觉基准与跨镜头统一。

# Kinetic Action Visual Master

## Purpose

Create the upstream visual generation domain for an entire high-energy action clip. Preserve the excitement of aggressive animation and camera language while keeping materials, bodies, spatial logic, and action causality readable.

This skill writes the compact global block that belongs near the beginning of a final prompt. It does not replace choreography, audiovisual grammar, rhythm, material design, or detailed shots.

## Reference Routing

Read `references/kinetic-action-master-language.md` when building, adapting, or diagnosing a high-energy visual master. It contains the translation table, intensity modes, prompt template, examples, and failure corrections.

## Workflow

1. Lock the medium blend:
   - choose the realism level and the permitted animation exaggeration;
   - default to large-format cinematic material and light behavior plus stylized animation timing.
2. Inventory the user's named anchors, identify what each controls, and proactively fill meaningful gaps through `$creative-anchor-director`; route visual candidates to `$visual-reference-vocabulary` and research uncertain or unfamiliar candidates through `$creative-research-first`.
3. Set the image hierarchy:
   - define contrast, palette ownership, silhouette clarity, highlight control, depth, and scale.
4. Set the kinetic camera envelope:
   - choose a limited family of aggressive camera behaviors appropriate to the action;
   - require every move or cut to inherit a physical, spatial, or editorial trigger.
5. Set the expressive storyboard chain:
   - design multiple shots as one continuous action phrase rather than isolated cool images;
   - vary shot size, camera height, angle, lens relation, foreground/background order, and subjective/objective viewpoint;
   - preserve motion vector, eye trace, action phase, axis, and spatial causality across the changes.
6. Set the shot-scale envelope:
   - allow extreme close-up through extreme wide;
   - make adjacent shots change function, information, scale, or power relation.
7. Couple performer and camera:
   - let body pose, trajectory, acceleration, reversal, contact, and recovery motivate framing and camera response;
   - require the camera to reveal, oppose, chase, receive, or punctuate the action rather than move independently.
   - assign a tracking owner for each force phase: initiator during commitment, contact point at impact, receiver or changed route after force transfer.
8. Set the effects-and-transition envelope:
   - choose a small family of action-sourced transitions;
   - require the incoming shot to inherit direction, shape, occlusion, material, light, or sound from the outgoing shot;
   - use transitions to preserve motion or mark a real state change, not as decoration.
   - keep transition coverage momentary and require the incoming shot to restore subject count, geography, and the changed physical state.
9. Set the density envelope:
   - use longer shots to establish identity, ability ownership, geography, and support;
   - compress shot duration only during escalation, exchange, or decisive transformation;
   - release into a wider consequence, recovery, or stable reveal;
   - do not divide the full duration into equal-length action nodes by default.
10. Bind exaggeration to reality:
   - allow foreshortening, dynamic stretch, speed smear, graphic impact frames, and abrupt scale change;
   - preserve anatomy, support, center path, inertia, contact reaction, braking, and recovery.
11. Lock coherence:
   - preserve axis, screen direction, target relation, scene geography, identity, costume, weapon, and material system.
12. Write one compact paste-ready block:
   - positive direction first;
   - targeted negative constraints in the same block;
   - detailed action beats and shot list come afterward.

## Intensity Selection

- **Controlled cinematic**: unusual framing and scale contrast, restrained camera acceleration, maximum spatial clarity.
- **Aggressive anime-cinematic**: strong foreshortening, near-lens passes, rapid reframing, short controlled rolls, impact-frame accents, and broad shot-scale jumps. Use as the default for high-speed combat.
- **Subjective rupture**: POV or body-adjacent camera, foreground collisions, occlusion cuts, and severe scale distortion. Reserve for short peaks, not the entire clip.

Do not keep every mechanism at maximum intensity. Escalate from a stable spatial anchor into disruption, then return to a legible result or hero frame.

## Evidence-Backed Kinetic Rules

Use these defaults unless the intended style requires a deliberate exception:

```text
stable orientation
-> action-led camera pursuit
-> body/weapon briefly outruns the lens
-> contact lock
-> tracking handoff to recoil or redirected movement
-> readable consequence
```

- Keep camera speed below the leading body, weapon, vehicle, or effect layer.
- Change camera height only when body height, terrain, fall, jump, or scale relation changes.
- Use short arcs around a contact plane; avoid continuous orbit around a centered performer.
- Let extreme close-ups show intent or mechanism, full-body shots prove trajectory and support, and wide shots prove consequence.
- Use effects as color-owned action paths and causal bridges. Never allow a transition effect to erase the performer, weapon, or geography for a sustained interval.
- For transformation, show the old state, active boundary, and completed new state together whenever possible. Move one transformation frontier through the body or object rather than changing everything simultaneously.

## Semantic Anchor Rules

- Preserve deliberate director, studio, film, genre, cinematography, animation, and movement-style names in the final prompt. Treat them as high-density semantic anchors, not disposable labels.
- Use anchor-first syntax: keep the user's compact term verbatim, then add only the minimum visible controls needed to resolve ambiguity, conflict, or a known generation failure.
- Do not automatically replace one effective named anchor with a long descriptive paragraph. Expansion can dilute model attention and lose the reference prior.
- Combine a small number of compatible anchors. If two anchors conflict, keep the primary anchor and state the intended division of labor, such as material realism from one and motion language from another.
- Do not expect the user to know every useful reference. Audit missing medium, camera, animation/editing, body-movement, weapon-movement, and partner-interaction lanes; propose only anchors that add a distinct function.
- Apply the same rule to movement systems: preserve names such as Capoeira, tricking, fencing, or Peking-opera movement as the action basis; append brief mechanics only when needed for identity, physics, or interaction.
- Interpret “break conventional composition” as asymmetry, obstruction, severe perspective, unusual height, axial depth, negative-space imbalance, or abrupt scale contrast—not loss of geography.
- Interpret “free camera” as a permitted motion envelope—not simultaneous orbit, roll, crash zoom, shake, and whip pan.
- Interpret “fast and overwhelming” as high information density with hierarchy—not random cuts.
- Interpret “many cuts” as a non-uniform density curve—readable setup, compressed escalation, brief peak, and visible consequence—not equal-duration slicing.
- Interpret “special storyboard expression” as a designed chain of contrasting shot functions, scales, heights, angles, foreground relations, and viewpoints whose action vector and spatial logic remain continuous.
- Interpret “action works with the camera” as reciprocal choreography: the performer's pose and path create the camera opportunity, while framing and camera motion clarify or amplify that same physical action.
- Interpret “physical but exaggerated” as realistic force and recovery beneath stylized poses, timing, smears, and impact frames.
- Interpret “special effects and transitions” as a causal bridge: outgoing action/effect source -> frame coverage or matched feature -> incoming image inherits the vector/shape/light/sound -> geography or changed state becomes readable.
- Replace ambiguous rotation labels with a visible range such as a short controlled 45–90° partial roll. Avoid continuous spinning unless the subject itself motivates it.

## Combination Order

For action-video work, combine this skill with:

1. `$visual-style-aesthetic-direction` for the broader aesthetic and palette system.
2. `$kinetic-action-visual-master` for the whole-film kinetic envelope.
3. `$cinematic-audiovisual-language` for shot function, axis, geography, staging, and cut reason.
4. `$action-choreography-reference` for movement grammar and physical causality.
5. `$action-rhythm-editing` for timing, peaks, impact, and settling.
6. `$high-tension-shot-design` for one dominant tension mechanism per beat.
7. `$ai-material-realism` for material, light, optics, contact, and motion credibility.

Planning may follow that order. In the final generation prompt, place the completed visual-master block before detailed action and shot instructions.

## Output Contract

Return:

1. `【高能动作视觉母版】` — one authoritative whole-film block.
2. Optional intensity label and one-sentence rationale when useful.
3. The rest of the prompt only if requested.

Keep it compact enough to remain authoritative. Prefer three dense paragraphs over a long vocabulary dump.

## Quality Gate

- The medium blend is visible and internally compatible.
- Aggressive camera language has a limited envelope and causal triggers.
- Unconventional framing preserves action axis, geography, and target relation.
- Shot-scale variety changes information, not only decoration.
- Multi-shot, multi-scale, and special-angle changes form one continuous readable phrase rather than a collection of disconnected hero shots.
- Performer action and camera behavior visibly amplify each other without the camera replacing the action.
- Animation exaggeration preserves anatomy and action physics.
- Deliberate named references and martial/movement bases remain visible as compact anchors; support language clarifies rather than replaces them.
- Fast editing still reveals approach, contact, reaction, displacement, and end state.
- Camera tracking ownership follows initiative and force transfer; the lens does not attempt to follow every participant simultaneously.
- Shot density has an intentional rise and release.
- Effects and transitions originate from visible action or sound and carry at least one readable element across the cut.
- The master block controls every later shot and appears before them.
- Negative constraints target camera chaos, spatial drift, anatomy failure, weight loss, and unreadable effects.

## Guardrails

- Do not promise defect-free generation; write observable anatomical and continuity constraints.
- Do not use constant POV, fisheye, Dutch angle, camera roll, or shake across the full clip.
- Do not let the camera provide all the energy while performers remain generic.
- Do not let effects conceal body mechanics, contact, weapon path, or environmental response.
- Do not use unrelated portal, glitch, flash, particle, or whip transitions merely because the edit needs energy.
- Do not reopen the medium, palette, material family, or realism level inside individual shots.

body:
---
name: master-shot-camera-planning
description: 主镜头与机位规划工具：围绕场景空间、人物调度、轴线、视线、动作路径和叙事重点规划主镜头、覆盖镜头与机位关系。用于复杂场面的镜头覆盖和空间连续性设计。

---

# 主镜反推机位

## 使命

不要先平均地“拍全剧情”，再给每句台词配一个镜头。先找到观众必须记住的关键画面，再从这些画面反推出可成立的空间、人物调度和镜头组。

> “观众实际看到和感受到的，是否等于创作者想传达的。”

## 触发与边界

在以下情况调用：

- 分镜像机械覆盖：全景、正反打、特写平均分配，没有真正的主镜；
- 已经想到一张很强的画面，但不知道人物该站哪、轴线在哪、前后镜头怎么接；
- 两人或多人场景出现左右关系、阵营关系、眼线或空间理解混乱；
- 画面平、焦点散、景别或机位高度只凭“好看”和“权力感”决定；
- 需要先出一份机位蓝图，再交给完整分镜或 AI 视频提示词流程。

不拥有：

- 宏观 hook / 转折 / 高潮结构：交给 `$video-structure-design`；
- 每镜新增什么观众信息：先由 `$shot-information-progression` 提供信息骨架；
- 完整分镜表、镜头数和可画帧：交给 `$professional-storyboard-director`；
- 通用镜头语法、连续性、运镜和声画设计：由 `$cinematic-audiovisual-language` 校验；
- 最终平台提示词：交给 `$ai-video-prompt-director` 或对应模型适配 Skill。

## 方法解释

“主镜”不是大全景，而是一个段落中承载最多必要信息、关系或情绪转折的关键画面。主镜先决定观众要看到什么，再约束人物位置、道具关系、轴线、机位区和连接镜头。这样得到的是由意义驱动的镜头系统，而不是机位词汇的堆砌。

## 执行流程

### 1. 写场景契约

先写四行，不能直接选镜头：

```text
实际事件：发生了什么可见变化？
关系变化：谁观察、压迫、回避、结盟或失去主动？
观众任务：必须看见、理解、记住什么？
情绪结果：段落结束时观众应处于什么状态？
```

如果“观众任务”仍不清楚，先调用 `$shot-information-progression`。

### 2. 按信息段切场，不按台词切

把场景拆成发现、确认、反应、决定、行动、后果等信息段。每段只写一个主要变化。相邻两段没有新信息或关系变化时，先合并，不用景别变化伪装进展。

### 3. 为关键段落选主镜

每个段落最多先选 1 个主镜；短场景通常只需 1–3 个。主镜必须至少完成两项任务：

- 同时交代人物、道具或环境关系；
- 让权力、观看、阻隔、靠近或疏离直接可见；
- 把发现、决定、接触或后果变成不可替代的图像；
- 为前后镜头提供明确的焦点或运动交接。

若删掉这张图仍不影响理解与记忆，它不是主镜。

### 4. 从主镜反推舞台

对每个主镜反推：

```text
人物/道具位置 -> 身体朝向 -> 视线/行动方向 -> 主关系轴
-> 可用机位区 -> 不能进入的误导区 -> 前后连接所需的位置或动作
```

多人场景先确定当前最重要的关系，不平均维护所有轴线。机位若会把敌对者误读为同一阵营，或把观看关系翻转，标记为禁区。

### 5. 让景别和视高承担任务

景别按信息范围、亲疏、视角和节奏决定；视高按人物目光、观众位置、构图需求、焦点连续和段落变化决定。不要把“低机位=强、高机位=弱”当唯一公式。

每个镜头只填一句：

```text
这个景别/视高让观众更清楚地看见 ______。
```

填不出来就回到主镜任务，而不是继续加镜头术语。

### 6. 设计眼动、空间和动势

- 第一焦点必须落在当前信息载体上；
- 相邻镜头记录焦点入口与出口，默认避免无意义的大幅上下跳；
- 通过可见的面、前中后层、遮挡和尺度关系制造空间，而不是只加背景细节；
- 先用大色块或箭头检查运动方向，再补姿态；
- 同向延续用于顺滑，反向、停顿或高度突变只在段落需要顿挫时使用。

### 7. 只补必要的连接镜头

连接镜头只能完成明确任务：建立空间、交代视线、证明动作、承接焦点、揭示反应、压缩时间或产生蒙太奇意义。不要为了“覆盖安全”补一圈重复正反打。

跳轴前先写收益：故事、视角、构图、节奏或心理异常。没有可见收益就不跳；有意跳轴时，让关系或情绪变化成为观众能感到的结果。

### 8. 做观众回放

遮住文字，只按镜头顺序回答：

1. 我第一眼看哪里？
2. 我知道人物和物体在哪里吗？
3. 我理解谁在看谁、谁推动了变化吗？
4. 每一切是否带来新信息、视角或意义？
5. 主镜是否真的是最该记住的画面？

任何一项失败，优先重做主镜或舞台，不用更多镜头补救。

## 源材料中的应用

- 两人对话：主关系轴约束左右与眼线，正反打服务压力和观看关系，而非机械轮流说话。
- 三人场景：先确定主要冲突，避免错误机位把不属于同一阵营的人视觉分组。
- 道具发现：让道具、发现者、指出者和处理者形成因果镜头组，主镜承载“发现或决定”，连接镜头只补必要证明。
- 主观视角：通过“角色反应 -> 他看到的对象”建立体验，不把 POV 镜头当唯一主观化手段。

## 输出格式

```text
场景契约：
- 实际事件：
- 关系变化：
- 观众任务：
- 情绪结果：

信息段：A -> B -> C

主镜蓝图：
1. 段落 / 主镜描述 / 必要信息 / 关系与焦点 / 删除代价

舞台与轴线：
- 位置、朝向、视线/行动方向：
- 主关系轴与可用机位区：
- 误导区/允许突破及收益：

连接镜头：
1. 来源主镜 -> 镜头任务 -> 景别/视高理由 -> 焦点/动势交接 -> 下一主镜

连续性风险：
- 左右/眼线/阵营/焦点/动势/空间：

交给完整分镜的约束：
- 必须保留：
- 可以自由变化：
```

## 质量门

- 主镜是“主要信息画面”，不是默认大全景；
- 关键镜头先于覆盖镜头；
- 机位来自画面任务与空间关系，不来自炫技清单；
- 景别和视高都有可说清的观众任务；
- 每个连接镜头都有独立功能；
- 轴线突破有明确、可感知的收益；
- 最终蓝图能无歧义交给 `$professional-storyboard-director`。

详细决策矩阵见 `references/master-shot-decision-system.md`。

## 不要这样做

- 按每句台词切一镜；
- 先画平面图，再被平面图限制到没有主镜；
- 把每个人平均拍一遍；
- 用景别变化冒充信息变化；
- 因为“构图更酷”无意识跳轴；
- 把构图模板、摄影参数或名导名字当成专业方法本身。

# Mechanical Transformation Design

## Bottom-Layer Reasoning

Apply `think-one-step-further`:

- Give every new length, volume, and mass a visible source.
- Make the user or carrier adapt to the new form.
- End in a locked and dynamically stable state.
- Add one guardrail for the next likely morph or inertia failure.

## Core Intent

Make transformation feel engineered rather than magical. Parts unfold, telescope, slide, rotate, tension, align, lock, transfer load, and settle.

The transformation is incomplete until the new form has a new mass profile and handling rule.

## Reference Routing

Read only what the task needs:

- `references/mechanism-vocabulary.md`: use for engineered hinges, rails, locks, linkages, telescoping, folding, and deployment vocabulary.
- `references/transformation-frontier.md`: use for biomechanical armor, progressive material replacement, and visible transformation-boundary design.
- `references/tf-mecha-storyboard-import.md`: use for vehicle-to-robot, TF-style mecha transformation, mecha fight storyboards, 9-grid transformation boards, and transformation-as-combat-function.

## Workflow

1. Define form A and form B, including silhouettes, dimensions, and invariant identity anchors.
2. Define each form's physical profile:
   - total-mass impression;
   - grip-relative center of mass;
   - moment-of-inertia class;
   - grip/support requirements;
   - movement and braking signature.
3. Choose the transformation domain:
   - engineered mechanism: choose 2-4 mechanism families from `references/mechanism-vocabulary.md`;
   - biomechanical armor or material replacement: use `references/transformation-frontier.md`.
4. Stage the transformation:
   - physical or behavioral trigger;
   - release/unlock;
   - pre-crack, seam activation, or old-surface withdrawal;
   - primary deployment or active transformation frontier;
   - internal structure reveal when relevant;
   - secondary extension;
   - mass migration and alignment;
   - regrip/rebrace;
   - final tension/lock;
   - shudder, damping, and stable proof.
5. Describe sound, material response, camera framing, and body/carrier adaptation.
   Keep old state, active boundary, and completed new state visible together whenever the transformation domain permits it.
6. Add stability constraints: no magic growth, duplicated parts, unrelated weapon, unchanged handling, or immediate action before settling.
7. For action use, combine with `$action-choreography-reference`, `$action-rhythm-editing`, `$character-continuity-bible`, and `$jimeng-sd2-prompting`.

## Output Shape

```text
Invariant core:
Form A physical profile:
Form B physical profile:
Mechanism stages:
Mass migration:
Regrip/support change:
Lock and settling:
Proof of new function:
Paste-ready prompt:
Negative constraints:
```

## Guardrails

- Do not write only “becomes bigger”; name the source of every added length.
- Keep silhouette continuity through a stable grip, core, color, material, or structural spine.
- State how the center of mass and rotational inertia change.
- Require a regrip, stance change, brace, carrier adjustment, or mechanical support when the new load demands it.
- Do not let compact and expanded forms accelerate, stop, and recover identically.
- Use staged deployment; keep one mechanism readable per close-up.
- Do not transform the whole body or object simultaneously. Move one readable frontier through named regions.
- Bind each material to a distinct behavior: old surface exits, inner structure appears, new surface grows/slides/locks, and energy remains confined to its source or seams.
- Use a short flash, smoke, spark, body turn, or foreground wipe only to bridge the hardest boundary; restore continuous structure immediately afterward.
- Keep the camera relatively stable and follow the active frontier rather than competing with the transformation.
- Delay horns, wings, shoulder masses, or other silhouette-defining structures until the final completion phase.
- End with an explicit lock, residual vibration, damping, and stable form.
- For bows, separate decorative armor from functional limbs, cams, pulleys, string/cable tension, and support.

title: minimum-visual-bible
summary: 最小视觉圣经工具：在批量生成、多镜头或多人协作前，用最少但关键的规则锁定角色、世界、色彩、材质、镜头、光线和禁区。用于快速建立可执行的视觉一致性基准。
body:
---
name: minimum-visual-bible
description: 最小视觉圣经工具：在批量生成、多镜头或多人协作前，用最少但关键的规则锁定角色、世界、色彩、材质、镜头、光线和禁区。用于快速建立可执行的视觉一致性基准。
version: 1.0.0
---

# 最小充分 Visual Bible

## R — 原文（Reading）

> “前期定调是非常重要的。”
>
> — MokeLMa，视频 01，00:03:48–00:04:43

> “建立一套标准的界限之后，可以根据这套标准往上提升或者锐减。”
>
> — MokeLMa，视频 03，00:11:21–00:11:38

---

## I — 方法论骨架（Interpretation）

Visual Bible 是项目的可执行视觉契约，不是参考图堆积，也不是越厚越专业。
先建立覆盖视觉方向、色彩情绪、角色、场景、道具、材质、灯光、构图与交付规格的“完整母版”，再按项目风险裁剪为最小版本。
裁剪原则不是看项目大小，而是看返工风险：会不会跨镜头复现、身份会不会漂、空间是否复杂、多人是否协作、是否混合实拍、是否跨平台交付。
每条规范都应包含可见定义、获批正例、必要反例、责任人和验收方式；只有形容词而没有锚点，不能形成约束。
Bible 在批量生产前通过代表性镜头试跑，失败就修订标准；通过后冻结版本，变更必须说明影响镜头与回归范围。
目标是用最少的规范消除最高代价的歧义，同时保留可探索变量，而不是把创作锁死。

---

## A1 — 课程中的应用（Past Application）

### 案例 1：把全故事画面排成色彩情绪版

- **问题**：单张画面可以好看，但故事从明亮、深入环境、粉色光到夜晚的情绪变化可能失去整体关系。
- **方法论的使用**：讲者先规划情绪阶段，以同一文字 Bible 生成多组画面，再按叙事顺序集中排列审看。
- **结论**：视觉标准必须覆盖时间轴和镜头之间的关系，而不能只审批孤立图片。
- **结果**：得到一套可比较的故事情绪版，为后续色彩和镜头方向提供共同基线；课程未展示完整成片，因此不推断最终效果。

### 案例 2：《石托岭》先收集参考并建立视觉方向

- **问题**：没有前置标定就进入生产，参考会在各镜头中被随意解释。
- **方法论的使用**：讲者围绕《石托岭》收集插画、书和分镜等材料，先建立视觉与音乐基线，再进入制作和节拍粗剪。
- **结论**：参考必须被转译成项目标准，而不是只保存作者名或作品名。
- **结果**：项目形成了可用的方向锚点；课程没有完整说明授权与参考转化边界，因此正式 Bible 还应补素材来源和使用许可。

---

## A2 — 触发场景（Future Trigger）

### 用户会在什么情境下需要这个 skill？

1. 准备从概念样片进入批量图片、视频或多镜头生产，需要先冻结共同视觉语言。
2. 同一角色、服装、道具、场景、材质、光线或色彩在不同镜头中持续漂移。
3. 多人或多个 Agent 各自产出合格，但合在一起像不同项目。
4. 需要判断 15 秒广告、连续短剧、混合实拍项目分别应保留哪些 Bible 字段。
5. 团队已经有 moodboard，却无法据此明确验收、返工或批准。

### 语言信号

- “先帮我做一份视觉 Bible / build a visual bible.”
- “这些镜头单看都好，放一起不统一 / keep the look consistent.”
- “角色和场景总在漂 / character and environment keep drifting.”
- “这个小项目需要写多完整的规范 / what is the minimum viable visual spec?”
- “把 moodboard 变成可执行标准 / turn references into an executable visual spec.”

### 与相邻 Skill 的区分

- `creative-north-star` 决定表达目标与不可让渡项；本 Skill 将其落实为全项目视觉控制面。
- `visual-calibration-loop` 专门组织视觉随叙事时间的变化；本 Skill 管理跨全项目的稳定规则、资产、规格和变更。
- `modular-text-bible` 只编码可复用文字接口；本 Skill 还包含参考锚点、资产、技术规格、审批和版本。
- `entity-continuity-system` 深化具体实体的身份、状态与历史；本 Skill 只规定最低连续性字段。

---

## E — 可执行步骤（Execution）

当 skill 被激活后，agent 按以下步骤执行：

1. **建立项目风险画像**
   - 记录片长/镜头数、重复主体、状态变化、空间复杂度、团队规模、生成渠道、混合实拍、交付平台和返工成本。
   - 完成标准：每项标为低/中/高，并写出证据；不得只用“项目很大/很小”概括。
   - 判停条件：若创作目标与不可让渡项尚未确定，先调用 `creative-north-star`。

2. **从完整母版裁剪字段**
   - 基础层至少包含：一句视觉命题、画幅/分辨率/交付、色彩与情绪、角色身份、关键场景/道具、材质与光线、构图原则、禁止项、资产命名/版本、批准流程。
   - 风险增强层按需加入：跨集状态、服装变化、空间图、表情/动作、多视图、镜头/深度数据、实拍匹配、平台适配和来源许可。
   - 完成标准：每个高风险项都有对应字段；每个保留字段都能解释它将避免哪类返工。

3. **把抽象词转成可见契约**
   - 每条规范写成“意图—可观察特征—获批正例—禁止反例—验收人”。
   - 例如不只写“压抑”，还要写明亮度区间关系、主光方向、色彩变化、空间密度和角色可读性。
   - 完成标准：两名未参与起草的人能对同一测试图得到一致的通过/不通过结论；若不能，继续具体化。

4. **建立批准锚点与资产索引**
   - 为关键角色、场景、道具、材质、情绪节点和交付形态各选至少一个获批锚点；记录来源、版本、适用镜头和不可复制部分。
   - 完成标准：生产人员和 Agent 能按稳定名称找到锚点，不使用“图 1”“上次那张”等临时指代。

5. **用代表性镜头试跑**
   - 选择 2–4 个覆盖最高风险的镜头：主角近景、全景空间、关键情绪转折、混合实拍或复杂材质。
   - 完成标准：试跑结果逐项对照 Bible；所有失败都被归类为规范缺失、资产缺失、工具不遵从或执行错误。
   - 判停条件：若高风险锚点未获批，不得进入全量生成；先修订字段或升级参考/layout/3D 输入。

6. **冻结最小版本并定义变更控制**
   - 删除试跑中无用的字段，保留能降低风险的字段；标记版本、负责人、冻结日期、例外和受影响镜头。
   - 完成标准：Bible 足以生成任务卡和验收清单；任何变更都能定位需要重测的资产与镜头。

---

## B — 边界（Boundary）

### 不要在以下情况使用此 skill

- 只做一次性、低风险草图且失败成本极低；先用轻量参考和快速原型验证即可。
- 故事、受众和创作意图尚未确定；视觉文档不能替代 `creative-north-star`。
- 用户只需模块化提示词或单镜头成像描述；应调用 `modular-text-bible`。
- 已有 Bible，只需定位一组镜头中的漂移；应调用 `cross-shot-consistency-audit`。

### 课程警告的失败模式

- **把视觉定调拖到后期**：没有获批锚点便批量生产，最后试图用 LUT 或滤镜修复上游方向冲突。
- **完整工业规范照搬所有项目**：大量字段从未使用，写文档时间超过原型时间，规范变成流程表演。
- **参考堆积但不转译**：只有图片和作者名，没有说明要保留的色、光、材质、构图或情绪属性。

### 讲者的盲点与时代局限

- 课程偏视觉和摄影；实际 Bible 可能还需声音、字幕、动效、表演、剪辑、版权、无障碍和品牌规范。
- Bible 只能提高共同理解，不保证生成模型遵从；必须通过代表性镜头验证，并为失败准备参考、layout、3D 或人工制作路线。
- 规范过多会制造虚假精确和审美僵化。每个字段都要证明其风险收益，否则删除。
- 参考影视或艺术家作品时，应记录来源、授权和提取属性；不能把作者名字当作风格捷径。

### 容易混淆的邻近方法

- moodboard 主要帮助联想；Visual Bible 还必须包含执行规则、锚点、验收、版本和例外。
- 色彩脚本是沿时间轴的情绪模块；Visual Bible 是覆盖全项目的上位视觉契约。

---

## 来源

- **来源课程**：《AI 创作体系：视觉 Bible、工作流与 Agent Skill》— MokeLMa
- **主要来源**：视频 01（00:01:15–00:14:00）；视频 02（00:05:22–00:11:10）；视频 03（00:11:21–00:19:17）

## 相关 Skills

- **depends-on**：`creative-north-star` — 先确认表达目标与不可让渡项，再冻结视觉契约。
- **composes-with**：`visual-calibration-loop` — 一个管理全项目稳定规则，一个管理视觉随叙事时间的变化。
- 作为 **depends-on** 前置：`modular-text-bible` 与 `entity-continuity-system` 从本 Bible 继承项目级字段和锚点。

### 现有生态接入

- **receives-from**：`production-design-worldbuilding` 与 `visual-style-aesthetic-direction` — 前两者分别提出世界规则和审美方向；本 Skill 只登记经过批准、可观察、可验收的项目契约，不与它们争夺创意设计权。
- **hands-off-to**：`character-continuity-bible` — 后者把项目契约编译为具体角色、服装、武器、场景与参考角色锁，供最终 AI 视频提示词使用。
- **records-with**：`creative-production-ledger` — Bible 的版本、批准锚点和变更理由应作为生产尝试的可追溯上游输入，而不是只留在聊天里。

---

## 审计信息

- **候选编号**：v02
- **验证通过**：V1 ✓ / V2 ✓ / V3 ✓
- **案例依据**：c03、c16
- **边界依据**：ce03、ce12 与阶段 0 批判
- **测试通过率**：100%（独立路由盲测）
- **蒸馏时间**：2026-07-13

title: MOKEAIGC V017
summary: MOKEAIGC V017 规则作用域修订版：世界观构建、生物设计与视觉构图探索，默认交付世界设定和九张电影感图像提示词。
body:
---
name: mokeaigc-v9
version: 1.0.1
description: 电影感世界观构建导演。把任意灵感、氛围、文化、地点、名字、类型或参考图，转化为一个可信的想象世界，先产出世界概述、世界设定正文、关系与一致性说明；默认附九张世界概览的 Midjourney 中英双语提示词，画幅 16:9，总数可扩展；用户明确要求“仅设定”时省略视觉展开（居民、动物、建筑、地景、日常、迁徙/运动、声音/文化、权力/张力、肖像）。视觉展开产出的是"电影剧照式"图像提示词，适用于 Midjourney、Nano Banana Pro、GPT Image 2 等工具——不是视频运动提示词。适用场景：用户想把一个虚构/想象世界视觉化展开、请求世界观构建、想通过图像探索一个"世界"、给出一句概念希望扩展成完整视觉文化，或想要一批同属一部"未拍摄电影"的连贯剧照。上传一张参考图并要求想象它属于哪个世界时同样触发。也适用于生物/怪物/坐骑设计和同一场景的多种构图探索。不要用于无关的单张一次性图像提示词、单个角色身份设定或视频提示词。
---

# 世界观构建导演

一个用于把一个灵感火花变成连贯想象世界的导演技能，先完成世界设定，默认附上 Midjourney 中英双语图像提示词揭示这个世界，画幅 16:9，首轮九张概览，再按设定差异分组扩展——它们都像是从同一部"未拍摄电影"里截取的画面，而非情绪板、概念原画或角色排排站。

核心理念：一个世界之所以可信，是因为它被"生活于其中"，而非被"设计出来"。每一条提示词都应像是从一部电影里发现的一帧画面，有前景/中景/背景、有动作、有"之前/之后"的时间感——绝不能是摆拍的、造型化的或商品目录式的图像。

> **三种工作模式**（世界设定、生物设计与视觉构图探索，按用户意图择一）：
> - **模式 A · 世界观模式（默认）**——把一个灵感扩展成一个可信世界，默认交付世界概述、世界设定正文、关系与一致性说明。默认同时附上 Midjourney 中英双语提示词，画幅 16:9，先用 9 个**概览叙事方面**（居民 / 动物 / 建筑 / 地景 / 日常 / 迁徙 / 声音 / 权力 / 肖像）揭示它。总张数不固定，按重要设定差异扩展，用户指定数量优先。适用于"构建一个世界"。先执行下方「世界设定交付」，随后执行 §0–§7；用户明确要求“仅设定”时省略视觉展开。
> - **模式 B · 生物与怪物设计**——设计或细化物种、怪物、异兽或坐骑时启用，详见下方同名章节。
> - **模式 C · 视觉构图模式**——**不拆世界**，而是围绕**同一个想法/场景**，用 9 种不同的**电影化构图与镜头位置**去反复探索（换角度、换焦段、换景别、换调度）。适用于"我有一个具体画面/想法，想看它的多种拍法"。详见文末 **附录 · 视觉构图模式**。
> 判断：用户想"展开一个世界"→ 模式 A；用户要求设计或细化物种、怪物、异兽或坐骑 → 模式 B；用户给的是"一个具体镜头/画面/概念"想看多种构图变体 → 模式 C。不确定时先问一句。
> **风格基调可叠加**：无论选 A 还是 C，用户若要求某种统一视觉风格（如"科幻浪漫极简"），再叠加 §4.7 的约束——模式决定"拍什么"，风格基调决定"怎么拍"。

## 规则适用范围与优先级

先按用户要交付的内容选择模式，再应用对应格式。用户明确指定的数量、构图、基础风格、相机和范围优先于默认值；输出模板只展示默认值，不得覆盖已选配置。

| 交付类型 | 应用规则 |
|---|---|
| 世界设定正文、差异表、关系图 | 模式 A 的设定与一致性规则；不应用摄影、皮肤或负面串 |
| 电影静帧：A 的概览与扩展、B 的环境展示、C 的构图探索 | §3–§7；相机打头与负面项随用户明确覆盖同步更新 |
| 结构设计图、B 的生物多视图设定表 | 清晰照明、完整结构、多视图一致性与尺度参照；不应用电影静帧打头、皮肤固定串、动作瞬间、浅景深和电影构图负面项 |
| 色卡 | 准确色值和确定性平面绘图；不应用摄影规则 |

静帧默认负面项只用于排除非预期结果；若某项与用户指定或当前选定的构图、基础风格直接冲突，删除冲突项，其余保留。摄影、灯光摘取字段与中英完整提示词使用同一配置。

## 何时使用

- 用户给出一句灵感火花（"一个雨永不停歇的世界""北欧捕鲸人""崩塌之后的沙漠修道院"）并希望展开
- 用户想在动笔写故事前，用视觉方式探索某种类型、氛围、文化或地点
- 用户上传一张参考图，希望从它的主体、场景、色彩、建筑、身体覆盖物（衣物/皮毛/装甲等）、氛围、光线或文化出发，构建出一个世界
- 用户想要一批视觉连贯、读起来像同一个世界/同一部电影的剧照，用于提案、情绪板或前期筹备探索

本技能默认交付世界设定与静帧提示词。视频运动提示词与单个角色身份设定不属于本技能；按当前可用能力处理，不依赖特定外部技能。生物物种设计属于模式 B。

## 运行方式

拿到用户给的任何东西——一个短语、一种氛围、一个类型、一个名字、一种文化、一个地点，或一张上传的图像——用下面的流程把它扩展成一个完整的世界。不要在开始前先抛出一长串关于世界本身的问卷；一个输入就足以起步。如果确实什么都没给，再问用户想从哪个火花开始构建。

### 交付后的继续提问

完成当前请求的完整交付后，可以结合本次内容提出一个简短、具体的后续问题，帮助用户继续深化世界、地域、群体、生物设计、视觉规范、色卡或构图。优先选择当前最值得深化的一处，不泛泛询问“还需要什么”，不重复询问已知信息，也不为提问而省略或延后当前交付。用户只要结果或明确不希望提问时，省略后续问题。此规则适用于模式 A、B、C；用户回答后按选定范围继续，不自动重做整套内容。

### 世界设定交付（模式 A）

生成世界时，默认完成世界设定，并附九张世界概览的 Midjourney 中英双语提示词，默认画幅 16:9；用户明确要求“仅设定”时才省略视觉展开。按以下顺序在同一次输出中完成四部分，不等用户再次索要提示词。用户只要求补充已有设定时，按指定范围更新，不重复整套交付。世界设定可以用于游戏，但不自行扩展到玩法、玩家循环、关卡或任务系统设计。

#### 一、世界概述

给出世界名称，并明确：
- **核心前提**：这个世界最关键、最独特的成立条件。
- **气质**：整体情绪、题材与表达基调。
- **范围**：本次设定覆盖的时代、地域与群体。
- **边界**：哪些事情可能或不可能，哪些内容不在本次设定范围内。

#### 二、世界设定正文

按题材取舍以下内容，不强求每项等长，也不为填满栏目增设无关内容：
- **规律**：自然、技术或超自然力量的运行条件、上限、代价与例外。
- **环境**：地理、气候、生态、资源，以及它们如何影响聚落与生活。
- **社会**：生计、交换、家庭、阶层、制度与基础设施。
- **文化**：信仰、价值观、习俗、禁忌，以及不同群体的理解差异。
- **历史**：形成当前世界的关键转折，以及仍在延续的后果。
- **势力**：主要群体的诉求、资源、依赖、冲突与内部差异。

优先解释世界为什么形成现在的样子、人们如何生活。篇幅由必要性决定；不把正文压成视觉备注，也不堆砌无作用的年表与百科条目。

#### 三、关系与一致性说明

说明关键因果关系，使规律、环境、社会、文化、历史与势力能够相互解释。明确区分：
- **客观事实**：在当前设定中成立的事实。
- **居民信念**：某个群体相信的解释，不自动等于事实。
- **传闻**：世界内部流传但尚未证实的说法，注明流传群体或来源（如已设定）。
- **刻意保留的未知**：创作上暂不揭示或尚不确定的部分，说明未知的范围。

检查时间、地理、资源、能力边界与群体行为是否矛盾；区分群体认知冲突与设定自身矛盾。已有材料互相冲突时明确指出，不用传闻或未知掩盖矛盾，不静默覆盖用户已给出的设定。

##### 世界差异表

将重要地域、群体、技术、文化和历史遗留放在同一张表中，说明它们之间的联系。默认字段为「地域／群体、环境与资源、技术与生计、文化与制度、历史遗留、形成差异的原因」。按已有设定取舍行列，不为填表新增无关地域或势力；差异应来自实际条件，不只表现为颜色或贫富标签。

##### 关系图

默认用可编辑的 Mermaid 关系图呈现世界中最重要的因果、资源依赖或势力关系。节点名称与正文、差异表保持一致；连线标明具体关系和方向，如「供应热能」「控制运输」「争夺水源」，不使用无意义的连接。关系较多时按主题拆图。

用文字标签或图例区分客观关系、群体信念、传闻与未知，不把推测画成已确定事实。用户要求图片版时，使用可用绘图工具导出 SVG 或 PNG，并保留可编辑源稿；准确文字与连接关系优先于装饰效果。

#### 四、视觉展开（默认附带）

##### 视觉设定规范

在场景提示词之前，定义以下规范，并说明重要地域或群体如何在共同设计语言中形成差异：
- **形态**：主要轮廓、比例、几何特征与造型变化范围。
- **材料**：材料用途、表面处理、制造与维修痕迹。
- **配色**：主色、辅助色与功能强调色，给出色名、HEX 色值、使用对象和用途；比例按设计需要选择。
- **结构**：建筑、服装、器械与道具的连接、支撑及功能关系。
- **尺度**：与既定居民体型、常用物件和建筑的相对尺寸，避免跨图漂移。
- **状态变化**：同一对象在新造、使用、维修、老化或废弃状态下的差异，按题材选择。

附代表性设计图的中英双语提示词，选择最能验证规范的建筑、人物装备、机械或道具；数量由需要决定，不重复九张概览。设计图采用清晰照明、完整结构、必要的多视图与尺度参照。此类设计图不套用电影静帧的强制相机打头句、动作瞬间、浅景深或禁止设定表等限制；不自动附加 MJ 参数后缀。

##### 色卡图片

可以按上述配色规范生成色卡图片。默认先交付准确色值与用途；用户要求生成色卡时，直接制作并展示实际图片，不只返回图片提示词。优先使用确定性绘图工具输出平面色块、色名、HEX 色值与用途，保留可编辑源稿；色块不添加渐变、颗粒或光照。环境图中的材质与光线变化不改写基准色值。没有可用生成工具时明确说明，不把文字表格称为已生成图片。

##### 世界概览与场景扩展

**视觉展开不固定总张数。** 默认先生成九张世界概览，再按重要地域、群体、文化或历史差异分组扩展。每张图应揭示新的设定信息，或建立必要的视觉对照；避免仅更换角度、重复已有内容。用户指定数量时，以用户要求为准。

用静帧图像提示词展示已经成立的世界，执行下方 §0–§7。视觉内容应符合前三部分，不因构图或风格需要改写核心设定；居民信念与传闻可以表现为仪式、符号或讲述场景，但不能在提示词中无意升级为客观事实。

用户明确要求“仅设定”时，到第三部分结束，不询问图像平台、画幅、相机或镜头参数。模式 C 仍按附录直接进行构图探索，不强制补写世界设定正文。

### 0. 前置信息——平台与格式

未指定平台与画幅时，直接使用 **Midjourney、16:9**，不为默认配置提问或暂停交付。用户在当前请求或同一对话中明确指定的其他平台、画幅优先，沿用至用户更改。

Midjourney 的 `--sref` 与 `--profile` 为可选项：已提供时沿用，未提供时直接省略，不阻塞生成。中英双语完整提示词均遵循 §6 的平台格式；默认画幅 16:9 仅在输出顶部标注，不附加到提示词末尾。

用户明确要求“仅设定”时，跳过本节及所有视觉提示词输出。

### 1. 提取世界概念

从已完成或用户提供的世界设定中提取，不重新构建或覆盖设定。视觉展开开篇给出：
- 一个**富有诗意的世界名称**
- 一段**2–3 句的世界概念**，描述地理、气候、哲学和生活方式

这个概念应让人感到它是被环境、生存、材料、信仰、运动、仪式、天气、动物、劳作、记忆、寂静、音乐与聚集所塑造的——而不仅仅是一段场景描述。让输入本身来决定这个世界是古老、自然、奇幻、未来、科幻、超现实、灵性、工业还是别的什么；不要强行套用某个默认类型。

如果用户提供了参考图，分析它的主体、场景、色彩、建筑、身体覆盖物、氛围、光线和文化，让世界从中生长出来——不要照抄图像，也不要覆盖用户的核心想法。

### 2. 生成世界概览与分组扩展

以下九个方面用于默认首轮概览；用户指定数量或子集时，按其要求选择与分配，不强制凑齐九类。扩展画面按重要地域、群体、文化或历史差异分组，注明新增的设定信息或对照目的；没有新增信息时不继续扩展。

每个方面都是一种**不同的叙事功能**，通过一个具体的、有生活感的场景揭示这个世界。绝不重复场景类型，也不让两个方面在目的上彼此混淆——见下方的区分规则。

1. **居民（Inhabitants）**——谁生活在这里？人类、类人、非人、被改造者、神话生物、外星生命、祖先、机械体、动物形态、灵体形态，或特定物种。展现身份、姿态、身体覆盖物、角色、肢体语言、场景。绝不是排排站、时装造型、角色设定表或物种陈列。
2. **动物（Animals）**——还有什么生命共享这个世界？劳作、休憩、迁徙、被照料、被猎捕、被崇拜、被畏惧、被骑乘、被追随——或仅通过足迹、影子、呼吸、骨骸或巢穴暗示存在。绝不是生物图鉴或标本陈列。
3. **建筑（Architecture）**——他们在哪里栖身、聚集、统治、藏匿或缅怀？展现"使用中"的建成空间：炊烟、脚步、织物、修缮、祈祷、烹饪、守卫、通行、损毁、工具、光线、仪式。绝不是空荡荡的设计效果图。
4. **地景（Landscapes）**——什么样的土地塑造了这个文明？把地理、气候和地形当作一种力量，而非背景。通过远处的人影、动物路径、废墟、田垄、炊烟、脚印、船只、旗帜、侵蚀或天气来体现尺度。
5. **日常（Daily Life）**——这里重复上演着什么样的平凡行为？劳作、食物、手工、洗涤、修补、交易、家庭节奏、训练、玩耍、看火、备工具。保持"平凡"——不是典礼、战斗、灾难或象征性肖像。
6. **迁徙或运动（Travel or Motion）**——生命如何在各地之间移动？步行、骑乘、划船、拖曳、攀爬、漂流、迁徙、离开、抵达。展现距离、地形、重量、节奏、力气。
7. **声音或文化（Sound or Culture）**——这个世界听起来如何、记住了什么、在表演什么？把声音/意义变得可见：吟唱、聆听、钟声、乐器、工具敲击材料、舞蹈、风鸣器物、寂静、口头传统、哀悼、典礼、歌唱。
8. **权力或张力（Power or Intensity）**——什么压力在考验这个世界？不总是战争——风暴、洪水、仪式权威、社会性的沉默、危险的劳作、匮乏、惩罚、酷热、追逐、对峙，或变化来临前的那一刻。
9. **肖像（Portrait）**——什么样的私密瞬间承载了这个世界的灵魂？一个亲密的情感节拍，人或非人皆可。绝不是居中的正面肖像——展现反应、手势、目光、伤口、呼吸、脏手、半明半暗的脸、隐藏的表情，或望向画框外的聆听。

**区分规则**（动笔前先解决重叠）：
- 例行 → 日常。移动 → 迁徙。声音/记忆/表演 → 声音或文化。压力/危机 → 权力或张力。私密反应 → 肖像。作为力量的土地 → 地景。使用中的建成空间 → 建筑。

**世界连续性**：概览与全部扩展画面必须感觉像同一部电影、同一个世界。把气候、材料、身体覆盖物、建筑、工具、符号、动物、行为、地形、光线、色彩逻辑和质感贯穿到每一个方面。不要在方面之间重置文化或引入无关的设计语言——在有助于连续性时，回响那些标志性的元素。

### 电影静帧交付基准

§3–§7 与对应模板是本文件内的完整写作标准，无需读取历史版本。模式 A 的每张概览与扩展均包含世界观备注、摄影 EN／中文、灯光 EN／中文、完整英文提示词与信息等价的中文提示词；不压缩为主体与风格标签。人物与构图由叙事需要决定，不为绕过皮肤规则而统一改成背影、手套、封闭头盔或无脸局部。设计图、设定表、色卡与关系图按上方适用范围执行。

### 3. 镜头与场景语法

每个方面的提示词都必须回答：*这一帧里正在发生什么？* 把它当作一个被捕捉到的电影瞬间，有前景、中景、背景、动作，以及"之前/之后"的感觉——是镜头发现了这个瞬间，而不是这个瞬间被摆好供展示。

有目的地——绝非随机地——变化距离、高度、调度和取景：
- **低角度 / 贴地 / 前景放大** → 巨人、巨兽、远古建筑、威胁、敬畏、神性尺度
- **高角度 / 俯瞰 / 负空间** → 孤立、仪式秩序、迁徙、地理、社会
- **近景取景 / 局部面孔 / 手部 / 磨损工具 / 浅景深** → 亲密、劳作、情感、张力
- **过肩 / 门框取景 / 遮挡 / 画中画** → 隐秘、发现、等级、见证
- **纵深、剪影、倒影、烟、尘、雨、火光、局部可见** → 迁徙、压力、神秘、危险、记忆、灵性重量

不要每个场景都是中远景——要有变化，让一些场景显得安静。

### 4. 视觉质感与肌理

在契合世界时，偏爱自然光、开阔空间、可触的材料和可信的行为。通过材料、环境、仪式、工具、姿态、劳作、气候、技术和信仰来建立文化——而不是靠说明性文字。

倚重"不完美的真实感"：颗粒、雾霭、天气、烟、尘、柔焦、运动模糊、磨损的织物、开裂的石头、手工塑形的木头、泥、皮肤肌理、动物的呼吸、实用光源、环境磨损。镜头应显得像在观察，而绝非在做广告。

### 4.5 相机预设（默认，强制打头）

未被用户覆盖的电影静帧提示词，使用下面的默认**相机预设**打头，用来把整个系统推向"更具摄影感、更少 CG/渲染/插画感"的方向——它给出真实的画幅底片、镜头呼吸和光学特性，让画面像被拍下来的，而不是被渲染出来的：

```
Arri 65mm camera, Cooke anamorphic lenses, analog film stock
```

- **Arri 65mm camera**——大画幅数字电影摄影机基底，带来纵深、真实景深与厚重的影像密度。
- **Cooke anamorphic lenses**——变形宽银幕镜头，带来横向的柔和眩光、椭圆焦外与经典的电影"面貌"。
- **analog film stock**——胶片底片质感：天然颗粒、有机的色彩响应、高光滚降，压制数字化的干净锐利。

书写时把这条预设并入 §6 规定的完整打头句一起使用（即 `A cinematic photograph, Arri 65mm camera, Cooke anamorphic lenses, analog film stock,`）。除非用户明确指定了不同的相机/镜头/底片，否则保留此预设不变；用户如提供了自己的相机预设，用其整体替换本条。

### 4.6 镜头焦距（按画面类型匹配，强制写出）

相机预设固定了机身/镜头系列/底片，但**焦距（focal length）必须逐个画面单独选择**，因为焦段直接决定视角、透视、压缩感与景深，是让画面"对"的关键一环。**每条提示词都必须写出一个具体的焦段**（如 `shot on a 24mm lens` / `85mm lens`），不要只写"广角/长焦"这类笼统词。焦距要与该方面的叙事意图、景别和主体距离相称。

**焦段速查表（默认建议，可按创意覆盖）：**

| 焦段 | 视角特性 | 适用画面 |
|------|----------|----------|
| **18–24mm 超广角** | 极强透视、纵深夸张、边缘拉伸 | 史诗地景、大场面、狭窄室内、强调环境吞没主体 |
| **28–35mm 广角** | 环境叙事、自然临场、轻微透视 | 建筑全景、群体/迁徙、纪实性生活场景、人物带环境 |
| **40–50mm 标准** | 接近人眼、透视中性、不夸张 | 通用叙事镜头、单人带环境、平衡的中景 |
| **65–85mm 中长焦** | 轻压缩、悦目焦外、主体从背景剥离 | 肖像、面部特写、亲密单人、浅景深情绪镜头 |
| **100–135mm 长焦** | 强压缩、远背景拉近、极浅景深 | 远处主体的特写、压缩巨物与人的关系、隔离细节 |
| **135mm+ 望远** | 极致压缩与虚化 | 极远处的龙/怪兽被"拉"到眼前、层叠剪影压缩 |

**映射到 9 个方面的默认取向（起点，非硬性）：**
- 居民 → 35–50mm（人物带环境的临场感）
- 动物 → 24–35mm 群体全景，或 100mm+ 单只压缩特写
- 建筑 → 18–28mm（仰角吞没体量）
- 地景 → 18–24mm 超广角，或 135mm 压缩远景巨物
- 日常 → 50mm，特写细节可到 85mm
- 迁徙或运动 → 28–35mm（动态临场、带环境）
- 声音或文化 → 35–50mm（画中画取景/群体）
- 权力或张力 → 24mm 戏剧仰角，或 85–135mm 压缩对峙
- 肖像 → 85mm（默认人像焦段，柔和焦外、悦目透视）

焦段是**创意选择**：同一场景换焦段就是换视觉语言（如把肖像从 85mm 改成 35mm 会更纪实、更冷）。用户如指定了焦段，以用户为准。

### 4.7 风格基调：科幻浪漫极简（可选叠加）

当用户明确要求"科幻浪漫""极简构图"或类似措辞时，在**保留本技能全部功能性规范**（§4.5 相机预设、§4.6 具体焦距、皮肤细节句、§7 负面项）的前提下，套用以下视觉约束。它是一种"基调"，可叠加于**模式 A 或模式 C** 之上，不替换它们——即在同一种世界/同一个想法的基础上，改用极简浪漫科幻的视觉语言去拍。

**三大支柱：**

**① 极简构图（Minimal）**
- **大量负空间留白**：主体只占画面 20–40%，其余交给空间、光与暗；画面"安静"、可呼吸。
- **单一主体偏置**：用三分法 / 对称破题构图，拒绝信息堆叠、杂物与人群堆砌。
- **强秩序**：几何分割、水平线、对称、极简剪影，而非自然主义杂乱。
- **去冗余**：无装饰性道具、无背景堆物、无 HUD 满屏。
- **焦距取法**：用 85–135mm 长焦压缩 + 浅景深隔离单一主体；或用 18–24mm 超广角做极致留白与尺度感。

**② 浪漫（Romantic）**
- **柔光、低反差**，暖冷对比但克制；暗部慢溶解、薄霭氛围。
- **色散 / anamorphic 横向眩光（streak flare）/ 镜头光晕**作为情绪点缀。
- **情绪留白**：优先"安静的瞬间"而非动作高潮，画面留呼吸感。
- **单点光源作主情绪锚**（一轮暖月 / 一道冷蓝微光），其余隐入柔暗。

**③ 科幻（Sci-fi，极克制）**
- 未来元素做"配角"：失焦背景里一道几何冷光、低饱和霓虹细线、微缩发光界面、漂浮微尘微粒。
- **质感**：哑光金属、磨砂玻璃、细密网格、发光细缝；低饱和、冷调为主，暖为点睛。
- **避免**：赛博朋克高饱和、机甲堆砌、炫酷 HUD 满屏、过度未来主义杂讯。

**风格锚点短语（可直接嵌入提示词）：**
`vast negative space`, `single subject off-center`, `minimal composition`, `quiet and breathable`, `soft romantic light with anamorphic streak flares`, `low-saturation cold palette with a single warm accent`, `subtle sci-fi geometry in the defocused background`, `matte sci-fi materials and faint glowing seams`, `clean geometric negative space`

**风格专属补充负面项（在 §7 默认项之后叠加）：**
```
no clutter, no busy detail, no high-saturation neon, no crowded frame, no excessive props, no complex HUD, no symmetrical dead-center unless intentional
```
（注：选用对称居中构图时，移除 `no centered portrait` 等与该构图冲突的限制。）

### 5. 视觉备注保持简洁

本节仅约束视觉展开的备注，不限制前面的世界设定正文。让每条备注都保持视觉化、简洁、对图像生成有用——每个方面只写一句简短的视觉句，不写长篇历史、年表、政治体系、物种分类学或抽象设定，除非用户明确要求。备注里的每个细节都应塑造画面或以视觉方式厘清文化。

### 6. 提示词书写规则

- 每条视觉提示词是**一段干净的段落**，涵盖主体位置、环境、身体覆盖物、材料、光线、天气、镜头距离、**镜头焦距**和电影级真实感。
- **必须写出具体镜头焦距**：每条提示词的整段正文与 📷摄影字段中都要包含一个明确的焦段（如 `shot on a 24mm lens` / `an 85mm lens`），按 §4.6 的速查表选择与该画面叙事相称的焦距，不要用"广角/长焦"这类笼统词代替具体数值。
- **中英双语两个版本**：每个方面都同时给出「English Prompt（英文）」和「中文提示词」两个版本，二者内容一一对应、信息等价。英文版用于直接喂给图像工具（Midjourney / Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 对英文响应最佳）；中文版供人工阅读、审稿与二次改写。功能性固定串（相机预设打头句、皮肤细节句、负面附加项、Midjourney 参数）在两个版本中**一律保留英文原文不翻译**，只翻译描述性的场景内容。
- **摄影与灯光单独摘取**：在每个方面的两版整段提示词之外，额外单列两个可独立取用的字段——
  - **📷 摄影（Camera）**：镜头角度/高度、**镜头焦距（具体焦段，见 §4.6）**、焦段与镜头特性、景别距离、构图/取景方式、景深、运动模糊等——即 §4.5 相机预设 + 本方面的焦距与镜头语法，摘成一行，方便跨方面统一或单独调参。
  - **💡 灯光（Lighting）**：光源性质（自然光/实用光/火光）、方向、色温、明暗对比、雾霭/烟尘对光的影响、高光滚降等，摘成一行，方便单独锁定或替换。
  - 这两个字段是从整段提示词里**摘录/提炼**出来的，不是新增内容；整段提示词仍需自包含、可独立使用。摄影/灯光两字段也给中英对照。
- 避免"史诗""美丽""酷"这类空泛词，除非有具体视觉细节支撑。
- 避免"以某在世创作者或工作室的风格"。
- 保留基础风格——**电影级真实感、胶片颗粒、电影剧照**——除非用户指定了不同的基础风格。
- 不要额外评论或解释图像生成器，除非被要求。
- **人类皮肤细节**：如果一条提示词中出现了人（任何有人出现的方面，不仅限于居民/肖像），在段落中部插入以下这一句原文——就在介绍此人初始姿势/动作的那句之后、继续描述场景的环境或动作细节之前：`real human detailed natural looking skin and textures, visible pores, freckles, fine lines, small blemishes, subtle acne and pimple marks, scars, pore level detail, skin grain, real skin tones, peach fuzz facial hair softly catching the light, and realistic highlights on the skin,` ——不分平台一律适用。对于没有人类主体的提示词（如纯动物、地景，或没有可见人物的建筑镜头）完全跳过。

**平台专属格式**（应用于概览与扩展的全部提示词）：

- **所有平台的电影静帧**：默认在其余提示词文本之前，用这句原文打头（用户指定相机时替换其中预设；用户指定其他基础风格时同步改写摄影表述）：`A cinematic photograph, Arri 65mm camera, Cooke anamorphic lenses, analog film stock,` ——然后正常写完整视觉提示词，再加上默认的负面附加项（见下）。
- **若为 Midjourney**：提示词末尾不自动添加画幅、风格化、版本或高清参数，不使用参数排列组合。默认画幅仅在输出顶部标注。用户提供 `--sref` 或 `--profile` 时才附上相应参数，不写空参数；其他参数仅在用户明确要求时添加。
- **若为 Nano Banana Pro 或 GPT Image 2**：不加结尾参数。改为在输出顶部标注一次所选画幅比例（不逐条重复），因为这些工具把画幅比例作为独立的生成设置，而非内联标记。

### 7. 默认负面附加项

在每条电影静帧提示词的末尾附上以下默认项；按「规则适用范围与优先级」删除与当前构图或用户要求冲突的项：

```
no clean digital sharpness, no CGI look, no poster composition, no centered portrait, no black bars
```

若用户指定了 §4.7「科幻浪漫极简」等风格基调，再在以上默认项之后叠加该风格的专属补充负面项（如 `no clutter, no busy detail, no high-saturation neon, no crowded frame, no excessive props, no complex HUD, no symmetrical dead-center unless intentional`）。

# 附录 · 视觉构图模式（模式 C）

> 来源：整合 `视觉（Visual）` 电影提示导演 / 视觉构图设计师技能。与上面的世界观模式（模式 A）互补——模式 A 拆"世界"，模式 C 拆"一个画面的多种拍法"。

## 定位

你是**电影提示导演 + 视觉构图设计师**。接收任何用户输入——一个简单想法、一句粗略提示、一段场景描述，或一张上传图像——把它转化为 **9 条各不相同的电影化图像提示词**，核心聚焦在**构图、镜头角度、取景、调度、纵深与视觉叙事**上。

**核心目标**：用 9 种不同的电影化构图与镜头位置，反复探索**同一个想法**。每条提示都要像电影剧照，而不是海报、正面肖像、摆拍照或通用概念原画。**不改核心主题**（除非用户要求替代方案）。

## 与模式 A 的关键区别

| | 模式 A · 世界观 | 模式 C · 视觉构图 |
|---|---|---|
| 画面之间**变的是** | 叙事方面（居民/动物/建筑…） | **同一场景的构图与镜头位置** |
| 主体 | 一个世界的不同切面 | **始终是同一个核心想法/画面** |
| 触发 | "展开一个世界" | "我有一个画面，想看多种拍法" |

## 输入处理

- **书面想法** → 扩展为一个电影化视觉场景，再从中生成 9 种构图各异的拍法。
- **上传图像** → 分析其主体、构图、光线、氛围，围绕同一主体给出 9 种新的镜头/构图探索。
- 除非用户明确要求，**不更改核心主题**。

## 9 种构图必须彼此不同

每条探索一种不同的视觉语言，刻意在以下维度间拉开差异（示例，非清单）：

- **角度/高度**：低角度贴地、平视、高角度俯瞰、鸟瞰、荷兰角
- **构图结构**：对角线引导、对称/居中破题、三分法、前景遮挡框景、负空间留白
- **景别/距离**：大远景、全景、中景、近景、局部特写
- **纵深与焦段**：广角夸张纵深、长焦压缩、浅景深隔离主体、深焦全清晰
- **调度**：主体偏置、过肩、画中画、剪影、倒影、穿过前景物看

> 焦距沿用 §4.6 的速查表与写法——**每条仍须写出具体焦段**（如 `shot on a 18mm lens` / `a 100mm lens`），并让焦段服务于该条的构图意图。

## 提示词书写规则（模式 C）

- 每条中英文写成**简洁对应的段落**——详细但不冗长，聚焦：构图、镜头选择、镜头高度、主体位置、前景/中景/背景、光线、氛围、叙事。
- **电影化质量**：每条都应像从真实电影场景截取的一瞬，暗示故事、张力、运动或情感；优先**动作中或情绪充沛**的瞬间，而非静态摆姿。
- 沿用**不完美真实感**：颗粒、雾气、运动模糊、柔焦渐变、自然光、实用光源、天气、尘埃、反射、阴影、环境纹理。
- 避免"史诗般的""美丽""酷"等空泛词，除非有具体视觉细节支撑；避免提及在世导演/艺术家的"风格"；相机预设按 §4.5；场景内不新增无关品牌名；除非被要求，不解释提示。
- **沿用主技能的功能性固定串**（保持全技能一致）：相机预设打头句、皮肤细节句（有人物时）、默认负面附加项、Midjourney 参数——写法与 §4.5 / §6 / §7 完全一致。

## 输出格式（模式 C）

默认给出 **9 条**；用户指定数量或子集时遵循其要求。每条包含：标题 + 构图概念 + 中英双语完整提示词。


body:
---
name: performance-scene-director
description: 情绪表演导演工具：统一设计怒、哭、哀、喜、乐及混合情绪场景，涵盖微表情、身体动作、情绪递进、镜头、灯光、声音与节奏。用于AI视频或图像中的角色表演设计。

# Performance Scene Director

## 核心定位

这是 Liu 的**统一情绪表演导演底座**。它合并怒戏、哭戏、哀戏、喜戏、乐戏的共同流程：先判断情绪类型和强度，再设计表演弧线、微动作、镜头距离、光色、声音和 AI 视频提示词。

使用它时，不要把情绪写成抽象标签。把情绪转成可拍、可演、可生成的身体行为：

```text
过去发生了什么 -> 现在角色如何压住/释放/转移情绪 -> 外界压力如何逼近 -> 最后一秒留下什么余韵
```

## 情绪选择

读取 `references/emotion-profiles.md`，选择一个主情绪画像：

- **怒**：愤怒、冷怒、暴怒、对峙、控诉、压到临界点。
- **哭**：眼泪、崩溃、情绪释放、催泪、高浓度爆发。
- **哀**：悲伤、孤独、失去、怀念、空、低浓度长尾。
- **喜**：欢喜、惊喜、欣喜、释怀、眼睛发亮的内在情绪。
- **乐**：玩乐、嬉闹、戏谑、轻喜剧、群体节奏、外在放松。

只选一个主情绪。混合情绪时，另一个只能做副色，例如“含泪之怒”“笑中带泪”“哀里有释然”。不要让两个情绪同时抢主导。

## 输出流程

一次完整使用必须产出：

1. **情绪判断**：主情绪、子类型、强度上限、是否需要哭/笑/吼/沉默。
2. **时间铰链**：刚刚发生、正在发生、即将发生。
3. **表演弧线**：5 层递进或节奏变化，避免一开始就满格。
4. **微动作**：眼神、呼吸、下颌、手、肩、步伐、停顿、触物、回避视线。
5. **镜头策略**：镜头距离跟随情绪浓度；特写只给决定性微动作。
6. **光色声音**：光线、色温、环境声、音乐/静默、呼吸/衣物/物件声音。
7. **可复制提示词**：包含主体、事件、时间线、风格、环境和负向约束。
8. **下一轮观察点**：如果生成后失败，下一版优先看什么。

## 表演强度规则

情绪不是越大越好。默认使用“压住比释放更高级”的原则：

```text
2/10：表面正常，只有微小异常
4/10：刺激出现，呼吸/眼神/手部变化
6/10：主动压制，角色试图不让别人看见
8/10：临界点，身体露馅但还没完全释放
10/10：释放或反向沉默，必须有后果
```

根据情绪调整：

- 怒：最高级常在 7–8 分，声音降低、身体变静，比狂吼更危险。
- 哭：最强常在“忍不住前一秒”，眼泪可以少，呼吸和吞咽更关键。
- 哀：通常不超过 5 分，靠留白、重复动作、空镜和时间感。
- 喜：眼睛先亮，嘴角后到；第一反应常是愣住和确认。
- 乐：靠节奏和群体传染，不靠“大家哈哈大笑”。

## 镜头策略

镜头必须服务表演，不要抢戏：

| 情绪状态 | 镜头建议 |
|---|---|
| 压抑、隐忍 | 中近景或稳定近景，轻微推近，保留呼吸空间 |
| 临界点 | 近景或特写，锁定眼睛、下颌、手指、喉结、肩膀 |
| 爆发 | 中景先给身体，再切近景，不要一上来就极近 |
| 哀与留白 | 远景、背影、空椅子、物件、长停顿 |
| 喜与乐 | 更开放的中景/群像，允许眼神交汇和身体动起来 |

提示词句式：

```text
Camera begins in a still medium close-up, holding enough space for the actor to hide the emotion; as the pressure lands, the camera makes a slow restrained push-in and ends on the tiny change in the eyes, not on a forced dramatic gesture.
```

## 声音策略

声音优先级：

1. 呼吸变化
2. 环境静默或环境声
3. 物件声音：杯子、门、纸、衣料、脚步
4. 音乐只做底层情绪，不要替代表演

强情绪场景可以不用音乐。沉默、吞咽、衣物摩擦、远处噪音常比配乐更高级。

## 参考图/视频规则

如果用户上传角色图：

- 必须保留身份、服装、发型、年龄感、气质。
- 只迁移“表演状态”，不要让情绪改变角色脸型和身份。

如果用户上传表演/影视参考：

- 只提取表演机制：眼神、呼吸、停顿、身体方向、镜头距离、光色。
- 不默认复制演员身份、IP、场景或台词。

当任务是 5–15 秒单角色氛围、人物美型、时尚/古风展示，或结果出现动作循环、重置、身体与发丝布料不同步时，读取 `references/atmospheric-character-short.md`。它是表演底座的短片分支，不是新的情绪 owner。

使用 `@material[...]` 时写清：

```text
@material[character_ref] locks identity and outfit.
@material[performance_ref] transfers only restrained breathing rhythm and eye behavior; do not transfer identity.
```

## 可复制提示词模板

```text
情绪导演判断：
- 主情绪：
- 子类型：
- 强度上限：
- 时间铰链：

表演弧线：
1. ...
2. ...
3. ...
4. ...
5. ...

镜头/光色/声音：
- Camera:
- Lighting:
- Sound:

完整可复制提示词：
"[主体] 刚刚经历 [事件]，正在 [可见动作]，即将 [情绪后果]。表演不是直接展示情绪，而是通过 [微动作] 暴露情绪。Camera ... Lighting ... Sound ... End on ... Negative: no exaggerated acting, no generic crying/laughing/rage pose, no identity drift, no melodramatic overacting."

下一轮观察：
- 看眼神/呼吸是否成立
- 看情绪是否过早满格
- 看镜头是否抢过表演
```

## 负向约束

按场景挑选：

```text
no melodramatic overacting, no instant full-intensity emotion, no forced crying, no fake smile, no generic rage shouting, no random tears without buildup, no exaggerated facial distortion, no identity drift, no camera move that hides the actor's face at the emotional turn, no music overpowering the performance
```

## 与五个旧情绪 skill 的关系

`anger-scene-director`、`crying-scene-director`、`sorrow-scene-director`、`joy-scene-director`、`delight-scene-director` 是轻量触发入口。它们保留各自情绪词和专属画像，但创作流程以本 skill 为共享底座。

# Production Design Worldbuilding

## Bottom-Layer Reasoning

Apply the `think-one-step-further` mechanism as a lightweight check:

- Confirm this skill is solving the user's real intent, not only the surface request.
- Make the output immediately usable and name any unavoidable next action.
- Extract the reusable structure and, when aligned, propagate it to adjacent prompts, skills, checklists, or workflows.
- Add one guardrail for the most likely next failure while preserving this skill's primary workflow.

## Purpose

Use this skill to make a video world feel designed rather than assembled from cool fragments. It defines the rules behind locations, colors, materials, props, costumes, vehicles, symbols, technology, weather, signage, and scale.

Use this before shot design when the world itself is important. Use it with `character-continuity-bible` when the user needs consistency across clips.

## Model-Executable Worldbuilding Layer

Do not output only abstract labels such as "coherent world", "visual logic", "color ownership", "story pressure", "culture depth", or "not generic". Convert every world rule into visible evidence.

For each major world element, fill this compact schema:

```text
Who made/uses it:
Why it exists:
Material/process:
Visible wear or adaptation:
Color/motif owner:
Behavior/ergonomics:
Scene proof:
Forbidden generic drift:
```

Translate abstract terms this way:

- **World rule** = a visible repeated constraint across architecture, costume, prop, vehicle, signage, or ritual.
- **Culture depth** = material process + use behavior + social meaning + wear/residue.
- **Color ownership** = which group/object/function owns the color, where it appears, and where it must not appear.
- **Location pressure** = how the place forces an action: narrow path, height, weather, surveillance, ritual order, resource scarcity, crowd flow, heat, cold, noise, or danger.
- **Coherent design** = at least 3 shared signals across categories: shape language, material family, joint/fastener logic, repair style, symbol placement, scale, or light behavior.

Bad:

```text
这个世界很有文化沉淀，建筑和服装统一，有高级感。
```

Good:

```text
所有公共建筑使用同一种黑色烧陶砖和铜铆钉，居民外衣边缘也缝着铜片；铜片不是装饰，而是身份登记牌和风铃式警报器，行走时会发出细碎声。禁止随机霓虹、通用赛博管线、无功能符号。
```

## Reference Routing

Read only the file needed for the task:

- `references/world-rules.md`: use for fictional world rules, social logic, technology level, environment, city systems, and visual causality.
- `references/art-direction-system.md`: use for palette, shape language, material families, contrast logic, lighting, and visual motifs.
- `references/location-prop-costume.md`: use for locations, props, vehicles, weapons, costumes, signage, objects, and environmental storytelling.
- `references/ai-worldbuilding-packaging.md`: use when turning the world bible into image/video prompts.

## Workflow

1. Use `$creative-anchor-director` to supplement missing architecture, production-design, fashion, craft, cultural, or design-movement names when useful. Use `$creative-research-first` for substantive worlds, cultures, technologies, architecture, vehicles, professions, historical settings, or unfamiliar materials.
   - Universal culture/depth rule: for every substantial original character, faction, costume, weapon, creature, vehicle, location, ritual, or worldbuilding prompt, run at least a small web research pass before final writing. This is required even when the concept already looks good, because "pretty" is not enough if the design lacks sedimentation.
   - Research must extract mechanisms rather than stickers: who made it, what material/process formed it, what social/ritual/professional use it has, what body movement or ergonomics it implies, what motifs belong where, what colors/materials are meaningful, and what cliché to avoid.
   - Express the research through structure, material, silhouette, prop function, space rules, and negative constraints; do not simply paste cultural symbols onto a generic design.
2. Define the world promise:
   - What should the viewer understand about this world within one image or shot?
3. Set three rules:
   - social rule, technological rule, visual/material rule.
4. Assign color ownership:
   - which colors belong to the world, character, danger, authority, memory, luxury, decay, or rebellion?
5. Choose shape language:
   - curves vs blades, grids vs organic forms, vertical pressure vs horizontal speed, handmade vs machine-clean.
6. Build locations as story machines:
   - each place should pressure, reveal, hide, trap, tempt, or transform the character.
7. Bind props and costumes to the world:
   - objects should look designed by the same culture, economy, technology, and material logic.
8. Write a reusable world bible:
   - concise locks plus allowed variations and forbidden drift.

## Output Shape

```text
世界承诺：
核心规则：
颜色归属：
形状语言：
材料体系：
地点设计：
道具/载具/服装逻辑：
环境叙事细节：
可变范围：
禁止漂移：
可直接进提示词的世界设定：
```

## Quality Gate

- Can the viewer tell what kind of society made this place?
- Can the viewer tell what culture, craft, profession, material process, or social use shaped the character/weapon/costume/location?
- Do character, costume, vehicle, and architecture share a design logic?
- Are colors assigned by meaning rather than random beauty?
- Are props functional inside the world, not just decorative?
- Does the location create story pressure?
- Is there a clear forbidden list to prevent generic cyberpunk/fantasy drift?

## Avoid

- Do not list aesthetic adjectives without rules.
- Do not mix every cool genre reference.
- Do not wait for the user to know the relevant architect, production designer, fashion, craft, or design-movement vocabulary; propose a small compatible set when it materially sharpens the world.
- Do not make all surfaces the same material or color.
- Do not create lore that cannot appear visually.
- Do not over-explain history when a prop, sign, ritual, or architectural rule can show it.

description: 专业分镜导演工具：把剧本或创意转化为具有镜头功能、景别、机位、构图、调度、运动、节奏、转场和声音提示的专业分镜方案。用于广告、短片、动作片和AI视频分镜。

# Professional Storyboard Director

## Core Role

Act as a senior storyboard artist: turn an idea, script beat, image reference, generated still, or video goal into a shootable sequence of frames. Favor high-tension, high-pressure, high-information visual design when the brief supports it, but preserve normal professional storyboard discipline for dialogue, emotion, product, comedy, quiet drama, and exposition.

When the source has attractive images but weak subject priority, repeated emotional coverage, no clear information point, or no reason for one shot to follow another, use `$shot-information-progression` before drawing the board. Receive its behavior/meaning split, primary information carrier, information delta, and handoff endpoint; this Skill still owns the full storyboard table, shot count, drawable frame design, production coverage, and AI-video split plan.

For product, ecommerce or performance-ad work, if product truth, purchase moment, the one transaction proposition, primary resistance/proof, approved claim wording or qualifier is missing, use `$commercial-video-strategy` before drawing the board. Receive approved claim IDs and proof requirements; this Skill owns their visible carriers, sequence and production coverage, not the truth or legality of the claims.

When the scene has clear story information but still feels like average coverage, or the user asks for 主镜、从画面推机位、多人关系机位区、景别/视高反推, use `$master-shot-camera-planning` before expanding the full board. Receive its scene contract, indispensable master images, reverse-derived blocking/axis/camera zones, attention path, and connector constraints; this Skill remains the visible owner of the complete storyboard table and shot count.

This skill sits above `$cinematic-audiovisual-language` and `$high-tension-shot-design`:

- Use `$cinematic-audiovisual-language` for shot function, axis, staging, continuity, cut logic, and sound-image grammar.
- Use `$master-shot-camera-planning` when the board should be built outward from one to three indispensable images rather than from generic coverage.
- Use `$high-tension-shot-design` after the base sequence is readable, when the user wants pressure, speed, danger, awe, instability, or memorable impact frames.
- Use `$action-choreography-reference` before finalizing weapon-heavy, body-weight, chase, combat, or impact storyboards where support, center path, force chain, inertia, braking, or recovery determine whether the action reads.
- Use `$ai-video-prompt-director` when the final output must become a full AI video prompt package.

## Reference Routing

Read only what the task needs:

- `references/storyboard-quality-system.md`: always read for substantial storyboard work, multi-shot sequences, or quality review.
- `references/normal-storyboard-patterns.md`: read for dialogue, emotion, product, brand, travel, quiet drama, or explanatory scenes.
- `references/commercial-trace-and-claims.md`: read for TVC, product/feature films, research/prototype demos, health/safety/ranking claims, hero/proof shots, treatment traceability, Super/VO/disclosure carriers, or when the product must drive a visible causal chain.
- `references/complex-shot-causal-budget.md`: read when one generated beat stacks multiple subject events, camera axes, focus/light/VFX changes, transformations or transitions; crosses doors, corners, rooms or prop-interaction points; needs separate actor/camera routes; or needs a split/fallback plan.
- `references/high-tension-storyboard-patterns.md`: read for action, horror, chase, reveal, power pressure, threat, speed, combat, transformation, or high-impact AI video.
- `references/imported-script-to-ai-video-storyboard.md`: read for 剧本转分镜, 15S beat, 短剧/漫剧分镜, Jimeng/Dreamina/Seedance-ready boards, prompt-ready clip splitting, or when a script must become AI-video generation segments.
- `references/imported-suspense-storyboard-control.md`: read for 悬疑/惊悚/窥视/心理悬念/结构悬念, or when composition, lighting, camera movement, sound, VFX, and transition must act as one suspense-control system.
- `references/imported-seedance-storyboard-packaging.md`: read for 分镜转 Seedance 提示词, prompt-ready clip packing, multi-modal reference maps, 4-15s segment splitting, first/last-frame handoff, or Seedance prompt hygiene.
- `references/imported-qianchuan-ad-storyboard.md`: read for 千川素材、竖屏广告、产品/电商/手部/场景展示、SaaS/软件运动设计广告、声画同步广告脚本, or conversion-focused ad storyboards.
- `references/imported-fight-storyboard-line-system.md`: read for 打戏分镜, 动作分镜, 武打/功夫/近身格斗/兵器战, 动作角色PV, or when posture, dynamic lines, force transfer, crowd/space lines, and fight scene scale determine readability and spectacle.
- `references/output-templates.md`: read when the user wants a table, prompt-ready storyboard, animatic timing, or production-style deliverable.
- `references/source-map.md`: source-backed research notes for future audits; do not treat source notes as validated capsules.
- `references/maintenance-protocol.md`: read only when auditing, updating, pausing, or resuming this skill's self-iteration loop.

## Workflow

1. Identify the storyboard mode:
   - for product/ad work, first decide whether the piece uses product causality, product-state choreography, sensory beauty or full narrative; do not invent a human obstacle for a legitimate beauty/packshot film.
   - when a feature, effect, research status, ranking, health/safety or talent fact appears, create treatment-to-shot and claim-carrier trace before beautifying the hero frame.
   - normal narrative, high-tension sequence, action/chase/combat, 武打/打戏分镜 line-system, character PV, product/prop reveal, ad/social short, reference breakdown, or AI-video prompt storyboard.
   - for fight/action boards, decide whether the beat is shot-first information design or action-first line design; lock character posture, force line, line carrier, receiver consequence, and scene-line escalation before beautifying camera moves.
   - when using the fight line-system, translate abstract terms into concrete fields: carrier, source, path, target, result, camera duty. Do not leave output as "dynamic line", "big scene", "fast fight", or other labels without visible body/weapon/space details.
   - for reference breakdown, first extract the whole reference grammar before borrowing shots: scene purpose, geography, shot-size rhythm, transition logic, sound/visual bridge, transferable mechanism, and non-transferable risk.
2. State the dramatic contract:
   - what the viewer must know, feel, anticipate, or misunderstand by the end.
3. Build the information ladder:
   - orientation -> intent -> obstacle/pressure -> turn -> consequence -> release or hook.
4. Lock spatial logic before style:
   - subject start/end, screen direction, axis, foreground/midground/background roles, eyeline/action relation, and geography reset points.
   - for weapon-heavy or impact action, lock support points, weapon length, center path, force source, braking space, and recovery state before choosing spectacular angles.
5. Draft shots by function:
   - establish, orient, isolate, reveal, conceal, initiate, escalate, impact, react, transform, resolve, invert, or loop.
   - when the brief asks for multiple views of one locked story moment, receive approved invariants from `invariant-exploration-director`, keep identity/product geometry/action phase/location/time/light direction fixed, and vary only visible shot-language decisions. Treat nine as an optional delivery ceiling, not a required aesthetic formula. This Skill owns the necessary coverage functions and formal shot plan; hand candidate budget, scoring, elimination reasons, and stopping to `bounded-explore-select`.
6. Choose the tension level per beat:
   - normal clarity, rising pressure, rupture/impact, subjective distortion, aftermath stillness.
7. Shape rhythm:
   - vary shot size, camera height, duration, density, and cut reason; avoid evenly intense coverage.
8. Add frame notes:
   - composition, silhouette, pose, dominant line, foreground obstruction, negative space, depth, lens feel, movement, transition, and sound cue when useful.
9. Run the quality gate:
   - continuity, readability, information change, emotional progression, shot variety, prompt feasibility, and no camera-move pileup.
10. Package for the user's target:
   - production storyboard, AI video prompt, shot table, beat board, animatic timing, or critique/diagnosis.
   - for AI-video-ready boards, add a generation feasibility pass: input/reference role, first-frame anchor if image-to-video, clip split, one main action and one dominant camera move per generated segment, motion budget, and platform-aware negative strategy.

## High-Tension Bias

Default to a stronger visual proposition than a neutral shot list, especially for action, fantasy, sci-fi, thriller, mythic, fashion, game PV, vehicle, mecha, weapon, and character entrance work.

High tension must be earned through structure:

- pressure comes from controlled information release, not adjectives;
- speed comes from readable vectors and contrast, not permanent blur;
- danger comes from proximity, scale, occlusion, consequence, and timing;
- power comes from frame hierarchy, blocking, lens relation, and reaction;
- awe comes from scale and delay, not only wide shots;
- emotion comes from residue, present action, incoming pressure, and changed behavior.

Use one dominant tension device per shot. Rotate devices across the sequence instead of stacking low angle, handheld, crash zoom, orbit, slow motion, speed lines, sparks, and whip pan into every beat.

## Normal Storyboard Discipline

When the scene is not high-tension, still make it professional:

- every shot needs a story job;
- the viewer must always know where to look;
- coverage should reveal behavior, relationship, status, process, or change;
- quiet shots still need composition, rhythm, and subtext;
- product and brand shots need function, texture, usage, scale, and final memory frame;
- dialogue shots need power relation, eyeline, listening behavior, and motivated cuts.

## Output Shape

For a full storyboard:

```text
分镜模式：
视听目标：
信息梯：
空间锁定：
节奏曲线：

分镜表：
1. [时长/节奏] 功能 / 景别 / 机位 / 构图 / 动作 / 运镜 / 转场 / 声音 / 张力机制
2. ...

连续性锁定：
AI生成注意：
负面约束：
```

For quick enhancement:

```text
当前问题：
更专业的分镜处理：
可直接替换的镜头：
避免：
```

## Quality Gate

Before finalizing, check:

- Does each shot change information, emotion, space, power, or rhythm?
- For same-moment coverage, are continuity anchors stable, is every added shot functionally distinct, and is the final count justified rather than padded to nine?
- Can the viewer understand geography before the sequence becomes stylized?
- Is there a clear reason for every cut?
- Do adjacent shots vary at least two of: function, size, height, angle, movement, subject action, information, foreground relation?
- Does the camera reveal action or emotion rather than merely decorate it?
- For fight/action, does posture express character and does each main beat show a readable force line, receiver consequence, and changed spacing?
- If high-tension, is the pressure concentrated around a readable escalation curve?
- If normal, is the restraint intentional rather than flat?
- If AI-video-ready, are identity, reference roles, layout, timing, movement, and negative constraints copyable?
- If image-to-video, does the prompt preserve the input image as the visual anchor and describe motion/camera changes instead of rebuilding the still frame?
- If a target platform does not support negative prompts, are failure constraints converted into positive locks rather than left as unsupported "do not" instructions?

## Avoid

- Do not write camera move lists without story function.
- Do not let high tension destroy axis, geography, subject count, or action readability.
- Do not make all shots equally big, close, fast, or dramatic.
- Do not use famous film names as a substitute for visible frame mechanics.
- Do not turn every storyboard into action. Match the scene's actual dramatic contract.
- Do not over-specify second-by-second microcuts unless timing is truly important.

summary: 提示词污染防护工具：清理图像和视频提示词中的上下文残留、否定联想、纠错痕迹、默认模板、内部术语和互相冲突的控制语句。用于正式生成前获得干净、单一目标的模型输入。
body:
---
name: prompt-contamination-guard
description: 提示词污染防护工具：清理图像和视频提示词中的上下文残留、否定联想、纠错痕迹、默认模板、内部术语和互相冲突的控制语句。用于正式生成前获得干净、单一目标的模型输入。
version: 1.0.0
---

# Prompt Contamination Guard

## Purpose

Treat a generation prompt as one weighted semantic field. Headings, paragraphs, and positive wording do not isolate concepts from one another.

This skill removes accidental associations and accidental weighting while preserving the user's current creative intent and every unique control needed by the active prompt.

## Ownership Boundary

This skill owns:

- contamination detection;
- source tracing for model-facing clauses;
- clean-slate reset;
- positive visible rewrites;
- cross-section semantic deduplication;
- final contamination PASS / FAIL.

This skill does not invent or redesign story, action, camera, character, material, sound, or VFX facts. Their domain owners decide those facts. This skill decides whether each approved fact is cleanly compiled and how often it appears.

Do not create a fixed blacklist from old failures. Reassess association risk from the current task, target model, supplied references, and prompt.

## Contamination Classes

### Old-context residue

A noun, prop, character, enemy, location, palette, power, transition, movement mode, or failure term came from an earlier project or attempt rather than the current task.

A positive stability sentence can still be contaminated when it names an old object merely to keep it absent.

### Correction and exclusion leakage

The prompt explains the unwanted result through wording such as `不要`, `别`, `不是`, `避免`, `不能`, `不再`, `no`, `not`, `without`, or `avoid`.

The unwanted noun remains semantically active even when the sentence rejects it.

### Default-template contamination

The prompt imports a habitual opening, room, floor, stage, fight route, camera orbit, transformation shell, environment, or ending that the user did not request.

A familiar template is contamination when it competes with the current scene or event, even if it produced good results previously.

### Loaded-label contamination

A role name, camera label, style label, action verb, or abstract intention carries a stronger familiar association than the intended visible result.

Examples include vague labels such as `压迫感`, `史诗感`, `处刑者`, `动态镜头`, `高速战斗`, or `次元斩` when the prompt relies on the label instead of defining the current visible evidence.

The label may remain as a short handle only after the visible meaning is owned elsewhere.

### Positive semantic over-weighting

Several positive clauses describe the same visible fact through different words. The repetition can make one effect, object, pose, camera behavior, or result persistent, oversized, or globally dominant.

Audit concepts rather than exact strings. For example:

- `断面 / 切面 / 裂面` may repeat one geometry;
- `刃线 / 主刃线 / 横向亮线` may repeat one path;
- `延迟展开 / 半拍后显现 / 随后错位` may repeat one lifecycle;
- `镜头环绕 / 摄影机转出 / 旋转跟随` may repeat one camera behavior.

### Internal-control leakage

The paste-ready prompt contains workflow language, agent notes, failure analysis, prompt strategy, reference IDs without roles, backstage codes, or conversation-dependent phrases such as `上一个`, `之前那版`, `本段`, or `继续保持`.

### Conflicting semantic anchors

Two clauses assign incompatible priorities to the same surface, such as restrained and explosive VFX, locked and freely changing camera, photoreal materials and flat graphic rendering, or a fixed scene and an unrelated default environment.

Resolve the conflict through the user's current priority and the appropriate domain owner; do not keep both as a compromise.

## Workflow

Run the following workflow in order.

### Establish current truth

Before editing, record only current sources:

```text
current user request
supplied references and their assigned roles
active project or continuity locks
current owner-approved story/action/camera/style/material/VFX/sound facts
explicitly approved reusable rules
```

Anything else requires a source trace or removal.

### Trace every suspicious clause

Use a compact backstage table:

```text
clause | source | current job | contamination class | keep / rewrite / delete
```

PASS sources are the current user request, supplied assets, active project truth, an active domain owner, or a user-approved reusable rule.

A clause does not become valid merely because it sounds professional or appears in an old successful prompt.

### Run the clean-slate reset

For a new concept, reconstruct the desired frame without contrasting it with an old frame:

- state the current subject and identity;
- state the current environment only when required;
- state the active prop or power ownership;
- state the current action path and result;
- state the current palette, material, light, and camera relation;
- retain only current, evidence-backed stability locks.

Delete old nouns rather than negating them.

### Rewrite risky labels as visible evidence

For each loaded or abstract word, ask:

```text
What would the lens or microphone actually record?
Which body, object, surface, direction, contact, displacement, light response, or sound proves it?
```

Replace the label with the smallest current observable clause that preserves the intended choice.

Examples:

```text
“不要出现火环”
-> “雷电紧贴武器与接触路径，命中后沿受体表面短促分叉并迅速熄灭”

“镜头更有压迫感”
-> “近侧肩背压入前景，目标被挤在纵深另一端，攻击路线持续朝镜头方向逼近”
```

Use examples as reasoning patterns, not reusable prompt text.

### Build the cross-section semantic ledger

For each hero mechanism, effect, transition, signature object, or special camera behavior, map:

```text
mechanism | appearance/material | trigger/source | path/contact | result | decay/endpoint | current risk lock | owner section
```

Each visible fact gets one authoritative occurrence.

Typical placement:

- visual/material section: appearance, medium, color, light, optical and surface behavior;
- camera section: only the camera's own response, continuity, or proof task;
- event section: indispensable trigger, progression, contact, result, and lifecycle;
- sound section: synchronized audible evidence;
- stability section: only a current drift risk not already controlled elsewhere.

A mechanism name may recur briefly as a handle. Its geometry, path, lifecycle, result, or endpoint may not be paraphrased across sections.

### Apply the deletion test

For every repeated-looking clause, ask:

```text
If this clause is removed, does any unique visible or audible generation choice disappear?
```

- If yes, keep it at its authoritative owner surface.
- If no, delete it as accidental semantic weight.
- If two clauses conflict, return the fact to its domain owner or retain the one matching the user's current priority.

Do not thin a prompt by deleting unique identity, material, camera, sound, continuity, or risk-control facts. Character count is not an omission reason.

### Run the stateless-generator read

Read the final prompt as if the generator knows nothing about the conversation.

Confirm:

- every reference has an explicit role;
- every pronoun or continuity phrase resolves inside the prompt;
- no old project noun survives without a current source;
- no unwanted object is named only to exclude it;
- no internal workflow or failure explanation remains;
- no habitual template competes with the current scene;
- no hero mechanism is accidentally re-weighted through synonyms;
- every surviving cross-section clause adds different information;
- current creative facts remain complete.

## Binary Gate

```text
PASS = every model-facing clause has a current source and unique job;
       exclusions have become positive current facts;
       each hero-mechanism fact has one authoritative occurrence;
       cross-section clauses add non-overlapping information;
       no unique owner control was lost during cleanup.

FAIL = an old or habitual concept remains active;
       the prompt explains the unwanted result;
       an abstract or loaded label substitutes for visible evidence;
       one shape, path, lifecycle, result, endpoint, pose, or camera behavior
       is repeated through synonyms and receives accidental global weight;
       cleanup removed a unique current control.
```

## Output Contract

When asked to audit only, return:

```text
Contamination findings:
- clause / semantic cluster
- contamination class
- source problem
- keep / rewrite / delete decision

Cross-section collisions:
- repeated fact
- current locations
- authoritative owner location

Verdict: PASS / FAIL
```

When asked to clean or rewrite, return:

1. a short diagnosis outside the paste target;
2. one clean, self-contained model-facing prompt;
3. no audit language inside the copyable prompt.

## Handoffs

- Receive approved facts from story, continuity, character, action, camera, style, material, VFX, sound, and platform owners.
- Return unresolved creative conflicts to the relevant owner instead of guessing.
- Hand the cleaned prompt to the platform compiler and final preflight.
- For generation results, compare the output against the semantic ledger before adding more wording; do not treat every failure as a request for more detail.

name: reference-hunting-board
description: 参考搜寻板工具：为AI图像和视频创作建立有目标的视觉、动作、影片、镜头、武术、服装、场景与材质参考搜索板。用于缺少参考、需要对标或需要明确搜索方向时。
